notes.title: Thai localization update!
notes.content: [p][/p][h1]Thai localization now available![/h1][p]We are expanding our list of supported languages by another one, Thai![/p][p][/p][p]Massive thank you to all contributors![/p][p][/p][p][b]Other changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved localization for all non-latin script languages (Chinese, Thai). Fixed an issue with line breaks in unnatural spaces.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the project to Godot 4.4[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Big thank you as well to everyone leaving feedback whether here in the Steam community or over at Itch.io! We are observing user sentiment with great interest... [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640802/0bf4fd1dfdd3703da2c040d8ef44b091ed3cb1f7.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Added compatibility launch options menu
notes.content: [h1]We've added launch options![/h1][p]Now when you click 'launch' on Steam you'll have to deal with a launch options menu.[/p][p]Sorry![/p][p]The good news is that there is a "always use this setting" option. If you press that one you'll never have to think about it again![/p][p][/p][h2]What exactly are those launch options?[/h2][p]Windows, MacOS, and Linux users can now choose whether to use Godot's Forward+ renderer (default option) or the compatibility renderer.[/p][p]We recommend the Forward+ renderer, but the compatibility renderer provides greater stability, especially on older or low-spec devices![/p][p]If your version of A Dark Forest ever crashed on startup or mid-game we strongly recommend trying out the compatibility renderer option for a spell![/p]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest + Press Kit!
notes.content:
[h1]Did you know we are taking part in the Steam Next Fest June 2025?[/h1][p]If you ever wanted to support A Dark Forest and its contributors, now's your chance![/p][p]Just share the word about our game with the world, encourage folks to wishlist it and talk about it, and play the demo a little bit![/p][p]It ain't much, but it sure would mean the world to our entire team! 🖤
 [/p][h1][/h1][h1]We now have a [url="https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1iUF3OQQ8mQSEzmO_zqEDD148yIlqEwMC?usp=sharing"]press kit[/url]! What is a press kit?[/h1][p][/p][p]A press kit includes materials useful for journalists and content creators. In our case it includes some text documents, a lot of in-game assets, promotional assets, the game's Steam trailer, and some other stuff.[/p][p][/p][p]Just a fan? Fun fact: there is no legal barrier from checking the press kit out even if you aren't the press! 👀[/p][p][/p][h1]Have you been wondering what we are working on? Here's a list![/h1][list][*][p]Reworking a certain hostile encounter to be more player friendly, regardless of skill level.[/p][/*][*][p]Introducing even more translations![/p][/*][*][p]Adding in special endings depending on player behavior in their current loop 👀[/p][/*][*][p]Adding in more Steam integration features! We'll definitely add in Steam achievements. Cloud saves... sound scary, but we'll try![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Talk about a game you love, save a dev! Doesn't have to be us! Sure would be nice though![/p]
